## Before publishing this pre-release

Run the manual smoke checklist on test accounts: [docs/qa/m5-smoke.md](https://github.com/dannickstark/Obsidian-Social-media-management/blob/HEAD/docs/qa/m5-smoke.md). Tick each section here, or list what failed.

- [ ] General (publisher device, secrets, phones)
- [ ] Telegram
- [ ] Discord
- [ ] Mastodon
- [ ] Bluesky
- [ ] WordPress
- [ ] Native scheduling (Mastodon and WordPress)
